Our architecture separates storage from query compute, allowing security teams to retain, search, and analyze massive volumes of telemetry and database activity directly inside their own object storage. We are a fast-moving, engineering-first team looking for an ambitious fresher full-stack engineer who loves solving hard systems and data problems. --- ### What You’ll Do * **Build End-to-End Features:** Design, develop, and ship responsive user interfaces and high-performance backend services. * **Learn & Work in a Modern Stack:** Write production backend services in **Rust** and build reactive frontends using **Svelte** (prior experience in these specific frameworks is not required—we will help you ramp up). * **Collaborate & Iterate:** Work closely with founders and senior engineers to translate product ideas into clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. * **Debug & Optimize:** Troubleshoot issues across the stack, improve application speed, and ensure system reliability. --- ### Who We’re Looking For * **Education & Experience:** Recent graduate who has completed **3–6 months of software engineering internship experience**, ideally after graduation. * **Strong Fundamentals:** Solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, databases, REST/WebSocket APIs, and modern web architecture. * **Language-Agnostic Problem Solver:** Proficiency in **any** frontend framework/language (e.g., React, Vue, Angular, vanilla JS/TS) and **any** backend language (e.g., Node.js, Python, Go, Java, C++). * **Curiosity & Adaptability:** Genuine excitement to learn **Rust** and **Svelte** on the job. * **Ownership Mindset:** Self-motivated and disciplined enough to thrive in a remote work environment. --- ### Good to Have (Not Mandatory) * Exposure to Rust, Svelte, or TypeScript. * Familiarity with Git, Docker, SQL/NoSQL databases, or cloud deployments. * Personal projects, open-source contributions, or hackathon builds you can walk us through. --- ### Hiring Process 1. **Application & Resume Screening** 2. **In-Person Technical Interview (Mandatory On-Site):** We believe great engineering starts with real conversations. While the role is **100% remote**, all interview rounds will be conducted strictly **in-person** at our office. * *Note on Coding Rounds:* You will **not** be tested on Rust or Svelte. You are free to interview in whichever frontend and backend languages you are most comfortable with. 3. **Final Offer** --- ### What We Offer * **Compensation:** ₹3,00,000 per annum. * **Remote Flexibility:** Work from anywhere once you join. * **High-Growth Learning:** Direct mentorship and hands-on experience building production systems in Rust and Svelte—two of the most loved and high-demand technologies in modern engineering. ---

We’re looking for an Associate Product Manager who wants to build products, not just manage roadmaps. Someone who is curious about why users behave the way they do, loves numbers, moves fast, and can turn a messy problem into a simple product experience.

What You’ll Do

• Own product problems end-to-end, from identifying the opportunity to launching, measuring, and iterating on the solution.
• Dive into user behaviour, product data, funnels, cohorts, and metrics to understand what’s working and what isn’t.
• Work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Growth and Operations to take ideas from a whiteboard to production.
• Design and run experiments, A/B tests and product iterations to improve engagement, retention, monetisation and overall user experience.
• Spend time understanding our users, their motivations, habits, pain points and what keeps them coming back.
• Break large, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable product initiatives.
• Track product metrics and build a strong understanding of what moves the needle and why.
• Bring new ideas to the table by studying consumer products, emerging trends and unconventional product experiences.
• Move quickly, test, learn, ship, and improve.

What We’re Looking For

• 1–3 years of experience in Product Management, preferably at a high-growth consumer internet startup.
• Graduate from a Tier 1 institute with strong academic and analytical fundamentals.
• Someone who is comfortable with numbers, data and metrics.
• Strong understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, retention and experimentation.
• Sharp problem-solving skills and the ability to structure ambiguous problems.
• High ownership and bias for action, you don't wait for perfect information to get started.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with engineers, designers and business teams.
• A natural curiosity about consumer behaviour, social products, entertainment and mobile-first experiences.

Note: The FRND team works 6 days a week, with the 1st and 3rd Saturdays being working days.

About FRND

FRND is redefining the way people connect by building social products that are engaging, safe, inclusive, and fun.

We’re a rapidly growing startup building for millions of users and solving unique challenges across social connection and entertainment. Our ambition is bold, and we're looking for people who want to build, experiment, and solve problems at scale.

Why FRND?

🌍 Impact at Scale: Work on products and initiatives that impact millions of users across India and international markets.
🚀 High Ownership: Take on meaningful problems and have the freedom to drive them from idea to execution.
🧠 Learn with the Best: Work closely with founders, leaders, and high-performing teams while solving real business challenges.
💼 Rewarding Journey: Competitive compensation, equity opportunities, and growth that matches your impact.
🎉 Work Hard, Have Fun: We're serious about building great products, but we also believe in enjoying the journey along the way.
💡 Solve Interesting Problems: Work in an environment where curiosity, experimentation, and first-principles thinking are encouraged.

Central Report Reviewer
Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. 

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. 

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: 
Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. 
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. 
Job Responsibilities
• Responsible for execution of Central Report Review activities on the study based on the
• Monitoring strategy defined, with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
• May support development of annotated visit reports such as PSV, SIV, IMV, COV & SCAN
• Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
• Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations/special Sponsor’s requirements and pharmacovigilance issues documented in the report. Immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to Clinical Trial Manager/Project Manager
• Documents observations noted during reviews and ensures protocol deviations or action items are reported as necessary in appropriate systems for action by CRA/CM or other functional team members.
• May assesses CRA/CM report quality, risks, and trends as well as operational performance and summarizes the findings for CTM review and action planning.
• Participates in clinical monitoring/project staff meetings and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements. Involves in regular project discussion and email correspondence to maintain the most up-to-date project status knowledge and progression.
• Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations.
• May support in CTM activities such as Protocol Deviation management, Action Items management, etc.

Additional Qualifications - 

• Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience

• 2 to 3 years’ relevant experience in Clinical monitoring is must

• Strong Verbal and written comm skills

• Fluency in MS Office applications

• Capable of working in an international environment skill

• Previous clinical trial experience in site management and clinical preferred

• Preferred experience in study management (as Lead CRA of equivalent)

• Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements

• Good documentation habits and skills, strong attention to detail

• Must demonstrate good computer skills and the ability to learn new technologies

• Good communication and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites

• Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving techniques to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues

Get to know Syneos Health
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

12b222ac5c606b05.description: **🏢 About the company** GreedyGame, founded in 2013 by Arpit Jain (CEO), is a leading ad-tech company driving app growth and monetization. We’ve built a sustainable, profitable business for over 7 years without chasing vanity metrics. The 0→1 journey is done, and we’re now scaling through the 1→10 phase. Trusted by Amazon, Dream11, MPL, Sharechat, Treebo, Mobikwik, and 1000+ publishers across 20+ countries. **📦 The products you’ll own** 📊 Pubscale: Monetization, user acquisition, revenue uplift, and business-growth analysis in a single place. 📱 Immersive Ads: Native, non-intrusive ad formats. Smart caching, priority loading, and adaptive refresh deliver better UX and higher monetization without annoying popups. 🎁 Offerwall: A reward-based engagement layer that monetizes non-paying users through personalized, high-conversion tasks, driving eCPMs up to $1000 in Tier 1 geos and up to 3X more revenue in emerging markets. 📈 AdX & GROW: Monetization via Google Ad Manager and premium demand partners, plus an AI-driven UA engine (GROW) with free credits and optimization support. **🎯 What you’ll do** * Own product surfaces end to end. Take publisher and internal dashboards (ad unit management, mediation, reporting, monitoring, operational workflows) from a product brief to production. That covers the React screens, the Go APIs, and the data model behind them. * Set the frontend bar. Define how we structure components, manage state and server data, handle loading, empty, and error states, and keep data-heavy pages fast, accessible, and responsive. * Build and evolve our design system. Grow a shared component library (tables, filters, date-range pickers, charts, forms) so teams ship consistent UI faster. * Design the APIs the UI needs. Write and extend Go services, shape response contracts for the client, and make sensible calls on pagination, aggregation, caching, and where computation should live. * Work with the data layer. Model and query PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, and work with analytical stores for reporting. Spot slow queries and N+1 patterns before they reach users. * Make it reliable. Add monitoring, error tracking, and tests where they matter. Debug production issues across the stack and drive fixes to the root cause. * Raise the team’s level. Review code, mentor interns and junior engineers, write clear technical proposals, and explain tradeoffs to product and engineering. **🔎 What we’re looking for** * 4–5 years building production web applications, with most of that time in React. * Deep React and TypeScript: hooks, composition, performance profiling, memoization, and when to reach for a state or data-fetching library such as React Query or Redux, and when not to. * Strong HTML and CSS fundamentals: layout, responsive design, accessibility (a11y), and attention to visual detail. * A track record of shipping complex tables, filters, charts, and dashboards over large datasets, with virtualization, pagination, and efficient re-rendering. * Hands-on backend experience in Go (or solid experience in another backend language and a willingness to go deep in Go): REST APIs, concurrency basics, testing. * Comfort with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and MongoDB, including schema design, indexing, and query optimization. * Experience with the delivery basics: Git workflows, CI/CD, code reviews, and production debugging. * Ownership: you scope work, flag risks early, and see features through to adoption. **✨ Bonus points** * Built or maintained a design system or component library. * Charting experience (Recharts, ECharts, D3, Highcharts) and data-visualization sense. * ClickHouse or BigQuery for analytics and reporting workloads. * Ad-tech, analytics, or B2B SaaS dashboard experience. * Frontend performance work: bundle splitting, Core Web Vitals, rendering large datasets. * Experience building MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or AI-assisted product features. * Startup experience or meaningful freelance or open-source work. **🤝 What makes you a great fit** * You think in screens, flows, and the job a publisher is trying to get done, and you push back when a flow doesn’t serve that job. * You write a clean, maintainable React and care about the details users actually notice. * You’re as comfortable opening a Go handler or a slow query as you are a component file, and you’ll build the API when the UI needs something that isn’t there yet. * You make pragmatic tradeoffs between speed and quality and explain them clearly. * You enjoy helping other engineers grow and leave codebases better than you found them. **🚀 Why GreedyGame** * Work on products used by millions, including Pubscale. * Real ownership of the screens and services that publishers and internal teams rely on every day. * A direct line to the CTO and a seat at the table on technical direction. * A learning stipend for books, courses, and conferences (we love curious minds), plus internal blogs. * Comprehensive benefits: health insurance, PTO, parental leave, and more. * A high-growth, inclusive, engineering-led culture that supports experimentation and impact.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Finance Operations (FinOps) team provides and enhances core business services that are the backbone of Stripe. FinOps uses data and operational excellence to deliver technology solutions, payroll services, operational excellence, and monetization services to Stripe.

What you'll do

We're looking for a Monetization Operations Analyst to join our growing team. You'll help us improve user experience through accurate and timely onboarding of contracts and workflows, and deliver improvements in our integrated financial systems with business partners, financial colleagues, and engineers.

Responsibilities

  • Onboard sold custom contracts into our billing systems.
  • Work with legal contracts with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Develop and manage scalable billing and collection processes for complex user agreements and new business operations.
  • Build scalable and auditable onboarding processes for new and existing users.
  • Partner with internal systems, global deal management, legal, sales ops, internal audit, go-to-market, engineering, and accounting teams to develop and improve processes for contract reviews and to anticipate changing business requirements.
  • Partner with account managers to resolve user inquiries related to onboarding implementation, billing, and collections.
  • Advocate for the customer to internal stakeholders. Share system feedback and insights with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Legal on innovation and improvements needed to optimize the Stripe user experience.
  • Help scope, build, and deliver continuous process improvements that enhance operations.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a client-facing role, ideally in customer success, consulting, financial services, account management, or sales, preferably working with technical products.
  • Track record of leading technical conversations and persuading others to take action based on requirements and value provided by solutions.
  • Ability to be detail-oriented while visualizing the larger impact of a series of transactions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate data and people to find answers.
  • Strong operating rigor, including organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally, including working with a team of sales and services peers.
  • Motivation and flexibility to work well in a high-growth environment where things change quickly.

Preferred qualifications

  • Ability to trace process impacts from situation to end customers and business financial outcomes.
  • Knowledge of or experience in the payments industry.
  • Demonstrated professional experience using GSuite, Excel, and working with large data sets.
  • Experience with SQL.
  • Demonstrated project management or consulting experience and the ability to work cross-functionally.
  • A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom.
  • A passion for learning and solving problems through infrastructure and automation.

Ruby Labs is a leading technology company specialising in innovative consumer products across multiple technology sectors. The company focuses on D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) subscription products. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/
About The Role
We are looking for Senior User Acquisition Manager (UAM) to take full ownership of TikTok acquisition for D2C products. This is a hands-on media buying role. You will be the owner of TikTok as an acquisition channel for your brand: from account structure, bidding and budget allocation to creative testing, measurement and scaling. You will work against real revenue data (CPA, ROAS, payback), not surface-level platform metrics, and you are expected to find and unlock new growth levers on your own.
We work AI-first, so we also expect you to use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, analysis, reporting and optimization.
Key Responsibilities
• 
Own all TikTok acquisition: strategy, execution, and results.
• 
Scale spend profitably across geos and funnels while holding CPA, ROAS and payback targets based on real revenue data.
• 
Build and optimize account structure, conversion events, bidding strategies and budget allocation (including Smart+ / automated campaign types, Spark Ads and other TikTok formats).
• 
Run a structured creative testing process: brief and iterate with the creative team, define hypotheses, decide what to kill and what to scale, and fight creative fatigue.
• 
Analyze performance daily and weekly, diagnose drops and spikes quickly, and act on them.
• 
Work with product, analytics and creative teams to improve funnels, signals and attribution quality.
• 
Maintain account health: handle ad disapprovals, appeals and restrictions, and build prevention-first habits so policy issues are caught before launch.
• 
Work with the TikTok team on betas, new campaign types, product changes and escalations.
• 
Document tests, learnings and playbooks so knowledge does not depend on one person.
• 
Use Claude and automation to speed up campaign builds, QA, reporting and optimization.
• 
Test new Paid Social Channels, such as: OpenAI Ads, X Ads, and others.
Qualifications
Must-Have Experience
• 
Senior: 5+ years of hands-on paid social / user acquisition experience.
• 
Strong hands-on TikTok Ads experience as a primary channel: scaling accounts profitably, not just running tests.
• 
Proven record of managing sizeable budgets independently: ideally $1M+/month on TikTok or paid social.
• 
Strong understanding of subscription / app economics: LTV, ROAS, payback windows, cohorts.
• 
Solid creative testing discipline and experience working with creative teams on concepts and iteration.
• 
Experience with policy issues: disapprovals, appeals, account restrictions.
• 
Analytical mindset: comfortable working with MMP / backend data and diagnosing performance from account-level data.
• 
Ownership mentality: able to run a channel end-to-end with minimal supervision.
• 
Clear, direct communication.
Strong Advantage
• 
Experience with D2C subscription, health, wellness or app products, and with web-to-app / web funnels.
• 
Experience with Meta or other paid social platforms alongside TikTok.
• 
Experience working directly with TikTok platform reps on betas and escalations.
• 
Experience building Claude, AI or automation workflows for media buying.
Location
Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.
Benefits
• 
Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
• 
Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
• 
Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
• 
Company-provided MacBook: Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
• 
Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Read more about it here: Independent Contractor Agreement
Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!
Interview Process
After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:
• 
Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
• 
Technical Interview (60 minutes)
• 
Final Interview (45 minutes)
Life at Ruby Labs
At Ruby Labs, we are more than a team; we're a community united in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation. Our combined passion fuels our ambition for excellence, driving impact that resonates around the globe.
We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that a diversity of thought and backgrounds builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, religion, color, place of birth, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military service status, or disability status. Join us and be part of a company that is crafting the future of technology across multiple industries.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

About the Role
We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly.

What You'll Do
• 
Train, tune, and test automatic target recognition and track management systems using the latest advancements in neural networks.
• 
Develop multi-sensor fusion and state estimation algorithms (Kalman filters, particle filters, multi-target tracking) running onboard resource-constrained vehicles.
• 
Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture.
• 
Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation.
• 
Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute.
• 
Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
• 
Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications
• 
MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience.
• 
Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar).
• 
Hands-on deep learning experience (training, evaluation, and deployment of neural networks for detection or classification).
• 
Strong programming skills in C++, Rust, Go, and/or Python.
• 
Track record of taking algorithms from research to deployment on a real system.

Preferred Qualifications
• 
Publications or deployed work in ATR, multi-sensor fusion, or distributed estimation.
• 
Experience with EO/IR, radar, or RF sensor processing on aerial platforms.
• 
Experience deploying ML models to embedded or edge hardware (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization).
• 
Familiarity with defense sensing and tracking problem domains.

ITAR requirement
To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer
• 
Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company
• 
Competitive base salary commensurate with experience
• 
Medical, dental, vision, and 401k
• 
PTO and paid sick leave
• 
Monthly wellness stipend
• 
Daily catered lunch (office)
• 
Paid parental leave
• 
Direct impact on a critical national security mission
• 
A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems
Compensation: $180K – $260K • Offers Equity

1207bf1bb1b550fb.description: **About the role** We’re looking for an experienced software engineer to help drive and evolve our data and AI security product. Our technology is new and rapidly evolving: you’ll be an early contributor with a substantial impact on the architecture and be solving multiple exciting technical challenges! **What you’ll do** - You'll design and implement highly scalable and fault-tolerant solutions to protect enterprise data across public clouds (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure), SaaS applications, and AI agents. - You'll build security capabilities that provide visibility into and control over how AI agents discover, access, process, and share sensitive enterprise data. - You'll solve real-world scaling problems that require thorough performance analysis and troubleshooting skills. - You'll work with a modern and constantly evolving microservices-based software stack that includes Go, Kubernetes, Bigtable, BigQuery, Spanner, Redis, Docker, and more. - You'll write robust, secure-by-design software that must withstand real-world attacks while processing untrusted data and communicating with hundreds of thousands of endpoints over the internet. - Located in Bangalore (Bengaluru), India **Who you are** - **Proven Expertise:** You have 5-8 yrs of industry experience in building high-scale security products. Experience in data security is highly preferred. - **AI Agents and Agentic Security**: You have experience building AI agents, agentic applications, or security solutions for AI agents. Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, and securing agent access to enterprise data is highly preferred. - **Cloud and SaaS Development**: You have extensive experience developing distributed application software for public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure) or SaaS applications. - **Data Integration at Scale**: You are skilled in integrating and ingesting large-scale data from third-party SaaS, PaaS, or IaaS APIs. - **Programming Skills**: You have extensive experience developing enterprise-scale applications, preferably in Go. Alternatively, you are proficient in Python, Java, or Rust. - **Database Proficiency**: Familiarity with GCP Bigtable, BigQuery, or graph databases such as Neo4j or AWS Neptune is a plus. - **Performance Optimization**: You have expertise in profiling and optimizing distributed code that interacts with large databases and streaming platforms. - **API and Microservices Development**: You are experienced in designing and implementing RESTful APIs, with hands-on knowledge of microservices and Kubernetes. - **Communication Skills**: You have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and are comfortable collaborating frequently with distributed teams across Europe, India, and the US. Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It. Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe. **AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking. *Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

12bed6e5778e78ae.description: We are seeking a skilled Investment Analyst to join our team in Maharashtra. As an Investment Analyst, you will be responsible for conducting thorough research and analysis of investment opportunities, assessing credit risk, and providing insights to support investment decisions. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze financial data and market trends to identify investment opportunities in ABS and MBS. - Conduct credit analysis to evaluate the risk associated with various investment options. - Prepare detailed reports and presentations to communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders. - Collaborate with other analysts and team members to develop investment strategies. - Monitor and evaluate the performance of existing investments, making recommendations for adjustments as necessary. Required Skills: - Strong analytical skills with a focus on investment analysis. - Knowledge of asset-backed securities (ABS) and mortgage-backed securities (MBS). - Experience in credit analysis and risk assessment. - Excellent communication and presentation skills. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for investment analysis and a desire to contribute to our team's success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Headquarters: Malta
 
URL: http://fpmarkets.com.au

Description

FP Markets Group of Companies is a well-established multi-regulated broker, founded in Australia, offering traders access to CFD trading on Forex, Indices, Commodities, Stocks and Cryptocurrencies. We are growing and looking to recruit a Full-time Global CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager (remote).
This role owns everything we say to a client between the moment they first raise their hand and the moment they place their first trade. You will design, build, send and continuously improve every automated and campaign communication across four funnel stages — Lead, Registration, First Time Deposit and First Time Trade — using email and WhatsApp, built and run in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This is a hands-on build-and-send role rather than a strategy role: you will have the support of content, creative and analytics teams, but the journeys are yours to build, and each stage carries a conversion rate that is yours to move.
Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer

Responsibilities:
Journey design & automation — Salesforce Marketing Cloud
• Own the design, build and optimisation of automated journeys across all four funnel stages
• Manage audience, segmentation, entry and suppression logic
• Rationalise existing automations and maintain a documented, auditable journey estate
Email execution
• Build, QA and deploy automated and campaign email communications
• Own templates and modular content to enable scalable regional localisation
• Manage deliverability, consent, preferences and list hygiene
WhatsApp execution
• Own WhatsApp marketing end to end, from opt-in and template approval to sequencing and frequency management
• Use data to determine channel allocation and optimise engagement
• Manage channel costs, forecasting and provider relationships
Optimisation & measurement
• Lead continuous testing across messaging, timing, channels, sequencing and offers
• Partner with Analytics to measure performance through to funded account and first trade
• Report on funnel conversion and explain key performance movements
Compliance
• Embed jurisdictional and regulatory requirements into journey design
• Partner with Compliance on efficient approvals and maintain a clear communications audit trail

Candidate profile:
• Proven hands-on experience building multi-step nurture journeys and automated flows in Salesforce Marketing Cloud. You must be able to demonstrate what you have personally built; applications without clear hands-on SFMC experience cannot be progressed
• Strong practical experience with Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Content Builder, Data Extensions and SQL for segmentation. AMPscript is an advantage; for Marketing Cloud Next, experience with Data Cloud, identity resolution and Flow is relevant
• Demonstrable experience running WhatsApp as a marketing channel, including opt-ins, template approvals and the 24-hour service window. Email-only experience is not sufficient
• Experience owning conversion performance, with clear examples of baseline results, changes made and measurable outcomes
• Solid knowledge of email deliverability, consent and data-protection requirements across multiple jurisdictions
• Comfortable writing automated-message copy and briefing creative where needed
• Fluent English, written and spoken

Our offer:
• Welcoming, young and multicultural team with approachable leadership
• Ability to contribute to dynamic business at a growth phase
• High level of autonomy, support of ideas and putting your expertise into the best practices for the company
• Continuous personal development, training budget, growth with the company and opportunity to learn from industry leaders
• Competitive remuneration, regular salary reviews and performance-based incentive schemes
• Vibrant company life: from team activities to global celebrations

Journey to FP Markets:
• Interview with HR (30 - 45 min) 
• Interview with your future manager (1h)

Join our team and be a part of a professional, rapidly-growing company operating in a multicultural environment!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/fp-markets-global-crm-lifecycle-marketing-manager
